# Export Biz

> Export Documentation & Business Management Workspace

Export Biz is an export operations and documentation platform built for manufacturers, merchant exporters, and multi-company trade groups. It centralizes export invoicing, packing lists, shipping bills, logistics compliance, and customer payment tracking.

## Core Capabilities
- Export Documentation: Generate, organize, and track commercial invoices, packing lists, and regulatory export forms.
- Order & Shipment Tracking: Monitor shipment milestones from proforma confirmation through customs dispatch.
- Customer & Receivables Management: Track outstanding receivables, bank realization certificates (eBRC), and duty drawdowns.
- Multi-Company Support: Run multiple export firms and trade branches under unified role-based controls.
